title: ophelia tetrapetala var. micrantha
intro: Ophelia tetrapetala var. micrantha, commonly known as Ophelia, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Ophelia include sedative and anxiolytic effects, as well as potential applications in treating insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Ophelia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
